content_sections.heading: About DCPU Saran
content_sections.text: The District Child Protection Unit (जिला बाल संरक्षण इकाई) is part of the Saran Collectorate. Its office is near Shri Nandan Pustakalaya, Sadhnapuri, Saran, Chhapra. It is filling these posts under guideline memo no. 748 and letter no. 749 of the Secretary, Social Welfare Department, Bihar, Patna, both dated 24.04.2026.

content_sections.heading: DCPU Saran Support Person Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: You must be older than 30 years and younger than 65 years. Age is counted as on 1 July 2026. The notice states that the age limit fixed for selecting members of the Child Welfare Committee in the state applies. You need one of the following: A postgraduate degree in Social Work (MSW), Sociology, Psychology, Child Development or Law; or A graduate degree in any discipline with a diploma in Child Rights or Counselling, plus three years of work experience. The notice treats at least three years of work in one of these fields as desirable: child rights, child protection, legal work, child psychology counselling, sociology or psychology. Preferred: experience with a District Legal Services Authority, a District Child Protection Unit, a Child Welfare Committee, a Juvenile Justice Board, a POCSO court or Childline services. You must be a citizen of India. You must be a resident of Saran district. Your record must be clean. No criminal case may be registered against you anywhere in India, and you must never have been found guilty of moral turpitude. You must submit an affidavit confirming this. You must not have been dismissed or blacklisted by any organisation working in child protection or child development. Check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: A selection committee chooses candidates on the basis of their educational qualification and an interview. The interview date will be posted on the notice board of the District Child Protection Unit, Saran and on saran.nic.in . The guidelines on Support Persons' service and duties will be posted in the same places. The list of candidates eligible for interview and the panel list will also be published on the website and the office notice board.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DCPU Saran Support Person Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Write your application and state the post you are applying for (Support Person). Attach self-attested photocopies of the documents listed below. Send it by registered post to: Assistant Director, District Child Protection Unit, Saran, near Shri Nandan Pustakalaya, Sadhnapuri, Saran, Chhapra. Or email it to [email protected] . Make sure it reaches the office within 21 days of 18 October 2026. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered. All educational qualification certificates Mark sheets Experience certificate Caste certificate Residence certificate An affidavit about your clean record and that you have never been found guilty of moral turpitude On the interview day, bring the originals of every certificate you attached to your application.

faq.question: Q1. How many Support Person posts are there in Saran?
faq.answer: There are 20 posts. Female candidates have 9 of them: 2 each in the SC/ST, BC/EBC and Minority groups, and 3 in Others/General.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must arrive within 21 days of the advertisement's publication. The cover letter gives the publication date as 18 October 2026, so the deadline works out to 8 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. How much does a Support Person earn?
faq.answer: Rs. 9000/- for each POCSO case, paid in three instalments.

faq.question: Q4. Can candidates from outside Saran district apply?
faq.answer: No. Only residents of Saran district can apply, and you must attach a residence certificate.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit and the cut-off date?
faq.answer: You must be older than 30 years and younger than 65 years on 1 July 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Can a graduate apply?
faq.answer: Yes. A graduate in any discipline can apply if they also have a diploma in Child Rights or Counselling and three years of work experience.

faq.question: Q7. Which experience is given preference?
faq.answer: Experience with a District Legal Services Authority, a District Child Protection Unit, a Child Welfare Committee, a Juvenile Justice Board, a POCSO court or Childline services.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. These are temporary posts based on POCSO cases, with empanelment for two years.

faq.question: Q9. Which email address should I send my application to?
faq.answer: Send it to [email protected] and state the post you are applying for. You can also send it by registered post to the Assistant Director, District Child Protection Unit, Saran at Sadhnapuri, Chhapra.

faq.question: Q10. What should I take to the interview?
faq.answer: The originals of every certificate you attached to your application.
